name: helm is available for the render tests
every vendored chart matches charts.lock.json and no unlisted tarball is present
every rendered release meets the global invariants
the harness refuses descriptor mistakes before helm can render an upstream default
site substitution keeps JSON valid and a local chart renders once per instance with the image from the lock
